en.headline: High-speed rail delayed after morning signalling fault
en.dek: The Transport Department said MTR reported a signalling fault shortly after 8am; at least 14 trains from West Kowloon were delayed before the operator said the fault had been cleared.
body: High-speed rail services from Hong Kong West Kowloon were delayed on Sunday morning after a signalling fault, the Transport Department said, citing a notice from the MTR Corporation at about 8.27am.

China Railway's 12306 system showed at least 14 departures from West Kowloon listed as delayed, including short-haul trains to Futian and Shenzhen North as well as longer-distance services to Guangzhou, Fuzhou, Xi'an and Chengdu. Local reports said some trains were due to leave more than 40 minutes late, while others that departed on time arrived at Shenzhen North more than half an hour behind schedule.

MTR later told the department the fault had been dealt with and that high-speed rail services were gradually returning to normal, according to RTHK and Oriental Daily. The department advised passengers to check 12306, the high-speed rail website or app, or notices at West Kowloon Station for individual train times.

zh.headline: 高鐵今晨信號故障 西九龍多班列車延誤
zh.dek: 運輸署早上約八時二十七分接獲港鐵通知，高鐵因信號故障延誤；12306顯示至少十四班由西九龍開出的列車受影響，其後港鐵指故障已處理。
body: 運輸署表示，今早約八時二十七分接獲港鐵公司通知，高速鐵路因信號故障出現延誤，港鐵正處理事故。
中國鐵路12306系統顯示，至少十四班由香港西九龍站開出的列車宣布延誤，包括往福田、深圳北的短途班次，以及往廣州、福州、西安、成都等地的長途車。本地報道指，部分班次預計延遲超過四十分鐘才開出，亦有列車準時開出，但抵達深圳北時延誤超過半小時。
港鐵其後通知運輸署，信號故障已經處理，高鐵列車服務逐步回復正常。港台及《東方日報》均有報道。運輸署呼籲乘客留意12306、高鐵網頁或流動應用程式，以及西九龍站公布的最新班次資料。
